project_info.theme: Minimal industrial triptych fitness editorial with an audio-theme prop system
project_info.creative_direction: Cinematic sports campaign replacing gym equipment with vintage boomboxes and cassette tapes
project_info.color_palette: deep navy, forest green, burgundy, warm concrete gray, off-white, and slightly desaturated amber highlights

main_subject.detail: fit adult woman with confident focused expression and hair tied in a high ponytail or braid
main_subject.wardrobe: dark navy, deep green, or burgundy retro-inspired athletic set with fitted sports bra, high-waisted shorts with side stripes, white crew socks, chunky white sneakers, and wristbands
main_subject.action: three grounded athletic poses: seated beside a boombox, lifting one on the shoulder, and standing with one leg bent while holding a cassette

composition_elements.framing: cinematic three-panel triptych with one large top panel and two smaller bottom panels
composition_elements.environment: minimal industrial concrete studio with scattered loose audio cassettes and stacked tapes used as workout-style props
composition_elements.top_panel: subject seated or leaning beside a large boombox, one arm resting on it, strong sunlight beam, headline STRENGTH IS EARNED. DISCIPLINE KEEPS IT., and small copy BUILT ON CONSISTENCY. DRIVEN BY FOCUS.
composition_elements.bottom_panels: left subject in a grounded slight squat holding a boombox with FOCUS. FUEL. FINISH.; right subject standing with one leg bent, cassette in hand, boombox on floor, and DISCIPLINE DRIVES DOMINANCE.
composition_elements.typography: bold fictional sans-serif campaign copy with no real brand logo; use a small abstract mark only

lighting_and_atmosphere.type: hard directional side sunlight at approximately 4300K with large white bounce fill
lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: dramatic concrete shadows, sculpted athletic form, warm slightly desaturated tones, subtle grain, and focused campaign energy

technical_specs.render_style: full-frame camera with 50mm lens, cinematic sports editorial photography and graphic layout
technical_specs.finish: high contrast, stable anatomy, crisp boombox texture, readable typography, subtle film grain, and clean panel dividers

prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a cinematic three-panel triptych fitness editorial image set in a minimal industrial concrete studio with dramatic side lighting and soft shadows. Feature a clearly adult athletic woman with a confident focused expression and hair tied in a high ponytail or braided style. Dress her in a dark navy, deep green, or burgundy retro-inspired athletic set: fitted sports bra, high-waisted shorts with side stripes, white crew socks, chunky white sneakers, and wristbands. Replace gym equipment with an audio theme: a vintage cassette player or boombox, loose audio cassettes scattered on the floor, and cassette tapes stacked like workout props. In the top panel, show her seated or leaning beside a large boombox with one arm resting on it and a strong sunlight beam across the scene, with the typography STRENGTH IS EARNED. DISCIPLINE KEEPS IT. and BUILT ON CONSISTENCY. DRIVEN BY FOCUS. In the bottom-left panel, show a dynamic grounded athletic pose holding or lifting a boombox with FOCUS. FUEL. FINISH. In the bottom-right panel, show her standing with one leg bent against the wall, holding a cassette, with a boombox on the floor and DISCIPLINE DRIVES DOMINANCE. Use bold fictional sans-serif typography, high contrast, warm slightly desaturated tones, subtle grain, and no real brand marks.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexual pose, fetish framing, ambiguous age, real brand logo, trademark, watermark, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, extra fingers, deformed anatomy, broken panel grid, illegible typography, melted boombox
